title: Light's Ultimate Death Trap in Part 3

series.summary: Light discovers that Misa traded half her lifespan again to Ryuk for Shinigami eyes, setting a ruthless trap that forces Rem to sacrifice herself to eliminate L.

cuts.voiceover_text: A single glance at the street outside reveals that an impossible trap is already moving in the shadows. Inside the investigation headquarters, the detectives celebrate their safety while playfully teasing Light Yagami about leaving his girlfriend waiting downstairs. Light calmly steps out into the open courtyard to meet Misa Amane. He walks toward her with a polite, innocent smile, but the moment his eyes look up, his blood runs cold. Hovering silently in the sky right above Misa is the towering, monstrous silhouette of Ryuk. The Shinigami is attached directly to her, and that single visual discovery exposes a terrifying move that changes the entire investigation.

Rem stares across the open space at Ryuk in absolute horror. The chilling truth hits instantly: Misa has traded away half of her remaining lifespan for the second time. Her life has been sliced in half twice now, leaving her with barely any time left to live. Rem trembles with profound dread and helplessness as the full trap becomes crystal clear. Light has deliberately pushed Misa into mortal danger to force Rem into making a fatal choice.

Sitting together inside the car, Misa looks at Light with a guilty frown. She admits that after losing her memories during confinement, she completely forgot L's true name. Light listens with quiet patience, but Misa quickly smiles and reveals the real news. She made the eye deal with Ryuk so she can look at L and read his real name all over again. Light stares at her in pure triumph: his plan is moving without a single mistake.

Light wraps his arms around Misa in a gentle embrace, whispering sweet promises of building an ideal world together where only kind people live. Misa weeps with intense relief and joy, burying her face deeply into his shoulder. She believes he truly loves her, completely unaware that she is just a disposable weapon in his master plan. Over her shoulder in the darkness, Light's face twists into a chilling, predatory smirk. Rem is trapped, L is completely blind to the coming execution, but how exactly will Light force the Shinigami to make the final move?
